subsystems.name: Feedstock collection and pretreatment
subsystems.role: gathers organic waste and converts it into a consistent, sterile nutrient stream.

subsystems.name: Bioreactor train
subsystems.role: grows microbes that convert waste-derived nutrients into protein or chemicals.

subsystems.name: Downstream processing
subsystems.role: separates the product from water, cells and impurities.

subsystems.name: Utilities and containment
subsystems.role: keeps cultures pure and manages heat, water and off-gases.

subsystems.name: Residue and nutrient recovery
subsystems.role: turns leftovers into biogas, fertiliser and reusable water.

subsystems.name: Automation and quality control
subsystems.role: monitors and steers continuous operation to food or chemical safety standards.

buildSteps.title: Map the city's organic waste
buildSteps.detail: Measure how much food waste, sewage sludge and green waste the city produces, its composition and how it varies by season.

buildSteps.title: Site the plant near the waste
buildSteps.detail: Co-locate with a wastewater treatment works or waste transfer station so feedstock, heat, power and water are close at hand.

buildSteps.title: Pretreat waste into feedstock
buildSteps.detail: Sort out plastics and metals, then use heat, pressure and enzymes to release sugars, amino acids and minerals into a liquid medium.

buildSteps.title: Build and seed bioreactors
buildSteps.detail: Install seed and production vessels, sterilise them, and introduce a pure culture of the chosen microbe.

buildSteps.title: Run fermentation
buildSteps.detail: Feed the controlled nutrient stream, supply oxygen if the microbe is aerobic, and hold temperature and pH steady while cells multiply.

buildSteps.title: Harvest and purify
buildSteps.detail: Centrifuge or filter the broth, then dry or extract the product to the grade needed for feed, food or chemicals.

buildSteps.title: Recover residues
buildSteps.detail: Send leftover solids and liquids to anaerobic digestion for biogas and fertiliser, and clean water for reuse.

buildSteps.title: Integrate and validate
buildSteps.detail: Connect to city heat, power and waste contracts, then win safety approval for the product and the process.

prerequisites.why: precision fermentation works on purified sugars, but few strains tolerate the variable, inhibitor-rich streams from mixed urban waste.
releasing fermentable sugars from mixed organic waste is proven in principle but still costly and inconsistent at city scale.
industrial bioreactors already run at hundreds of cubic metres for antibiotics, enzymes and food ingredients.
centrifuges, filters and dryers are standard in food and chemical plants.
collection systems exist, but using municipal waste to make food or feed faces strict safety and labelling rules.

pathway.milestone: city wastewater plants and anaerobic digesters turn organic waste into biogas and fertiliser, while precision fermentation makes some proteins from sugar
pathway.unlocks: a working waste-to-value base and commercial fermentation skills.

pathway.milestone: pilot plants co-located with waste facilities convert the organic fraction of municipal waste into single-cell protein or industrial chemicals
pathway.unlocks: real data on yields, contamination and cost at city scale.

pathway.milestone: city-scale bioreactor networks linked to waste collection, with product approved first for animal feed then food
pathway.unlocks: local protein and chemical supply that displaces imports and landfill.

pathway.milestone: circular urban bio-manufacturing where a city's waste becomes protein, materials and fertiliser
pathway.unlocks: resilient, low-carbon urban supply chains for food and chemicals.
